newsitem.title: USA: U.S. aluminum output up in July - Aluminum Ass'n.
newsitem.headline: U.S. aluminum output up in July - Aluminum Ass'n.

text.p: Average daily primary aluminum output in the United States in July totaled 9,846 tonnes, down 0.2 percent from June, which totaled 9,872 tonnes, and up 1.2 percent from July 1996, which totaled 9,725 tonnes, according to the Aluminum Association.
July output totaled 305,219 tonnes, up three percent from 296,170 tonnes in June and up 1.2 percent from last July, which totaled 301,488 tonnes.
Production in the first seven months of the year totaled 2,091,025 tonnes, up 0.6 percent from 2,078,313 in last year's corresponding period.
